title: Tiered rollout signal matrix, release-notes templates, and cut criteria for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Morgan Lee
description: Create a coordinated playbook that defines tiered rollout signals (go/no-go metrics), standardized release-notes templates (API, Console, Runtime), and explicit cut criteria for feature scope lock across the API/Console/Runtime release train. This ticket covers templates, comms cadence, localization gating, embargo windows, rollback triggers, and a small signal dashboard used by PM/Eng/SRE for launch day decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Publish canonical release-notes templates for API, Console, and Runtime with required sections and examples
Document and ratify cut criteria (P0/P1/P2 tolerances) and scope-lock process in Confluence
Tiered rollout signal matrix for Canary -> Limited -> General must exist with concrete metrics and thresholds
Rollout dashboard (links to latency, error-rate, token-cost, and customer-usage) accessible to launch cadence group
Runbook with explicit rollback triggers and owner assignments completed and reviewed by SRE
Localization gating checklist produced for supported markets (EN, DE, FR, JP) and translation timeline aligned
Stakeholder sign-offs from Eng, Design, SRE, Legal, and Growth recorded in comments
deliverables: Confluence playbook: Tiered Rollout Matrix + Cut Criteria
Launch signals dashboard (Grafana board link) with alert thresholds
Comms schedule and embargo windows spreadsheet
One-page rollback playbook and owner roster
Localization schedule and sample translated release notes
communication_plan: Weekly triage sync with ENG/SRE/DES (Mon 10:00 PT) during scope window
Pre-launch readout 72 hours before canary: product PR and exec summary to ExecComm
72h/24h/4h launch check-ins with triage channel #launch-2026q2 and pinned runbook
Release notes publishing: draft -> peer review (Docs) -> translations -> publish under embargo
Customer-facing changelog bundle to Growth for targeted outreach after GA
risks_mitigations: Risk: Runtime regressions cause latency spikes at canary. Mitigation: reduce canary traffic to 5% and enable automatic fallback to stable model variant
Risk: Release notes inconsistencies across surfaces. Mitigation: single source-of-truth templates + docs PR checklist
Risk: Localization delays. Mitigation: freeze English content 72h before publish and trigger parallel translation queues with priority labels
Risk: Ambiguous rollback ownership. Mitigation: explicit owner matrix in runbook and daily handoff during launch window
